    • KfeFinancialOperationsAdminAdapter

      public KfeFinancialOperationsAdminAdapter(org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<BitcoinCoreRpcClient> bitcoinCoreRpcClient, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<LightningClient> lightningClient, KfeAuditLogRepository auditLogRepository, KfeTransactionRepository transactionRepository, KfeExecutionOutboxRepository outboxRepository)
      Creates the adapter with mandatory audit, transaction, and execution-outbox stores plus lazy optional providers for external payment rails.
      Parameters:
      bitcoinCoreRpcClient - optional Bitcoin Core health-probe client
      lightningClient - optional Lightning health-probe client
      auditLogRepository - ordered audit event store
      transactionRepository - financial transaction store
      outboxRepository - execution outbox store

  • Method Details

    • blockchain

      public Map<String,Object> blockchain()
      Probes Bitcoin Core blockchain, mempool, and fee-estimation RPCs and returns a compact health view. Missing configuration and runtime RPC errors are represented as DOWN; a successful probe with no blocks is DEGRADED. The response includes chain sync/pruning and mempool fee data.
      Specified by:
      blockchain in interface com.kerosene.common.financial.operations.FinancialOperationsAdminPort
      Returns:
      operational status map with source, observation time, selected chain/mempool data, and a safe error summary

    • lightning

      public Map<String,Object> lightning()
      Probes the Lightning provider for local/remote/node balances, uptime, and LSP latency. Missing configuration or provider exceptions map to DOWN; a configured node with nonpositive uptime maps to DEGRADED.
      Specified by:
      lightning in interface com.kerosene.common.financial.operations.FinancialOperationsAdminPort
      Returns:
      operational status map containing the summarized node health or failure category

    • logs

      public List<Map<String,Object>> logs(int limit)
      Returns the newest audit entries, bounded to between one and one hundred rows, after removing raw transaction and wallet identifiers through stable fingerprints.
      Specified by:
      logs in interface com.kerosene.common.financial.operations.FinancialOperationsAdminPort
      Parameters:
      limit - requested maximum number of rows; values outside 1..100 are clamped
      Returns:
      newest-first list of safe audit fields and pseudonymous transaction/wallet references

    • metrics

      public Map<String,Object> metrics()
      Computes aggregate transaction volume, fees, ticket size, state/rail counts, and outbox counts. Optional payment-request and notification outbox counts are included only when their repositories are wired. No per-user timeline, destination, transaction ID, invoice content, or wallet name is emitted.
      Specified by:
      metrics in interface com.kerosene.common.financial.operations.FinancialOperationsAdminPort
      Returns:
      aggregate metric map with a sampling timestamp and explicit privacy boundary
